rules_summary.house_logic: The house takes the side opposite lopsided public money. House liability score = money % on the public side + 10 heavy-ML anchor + 8 prime time + 5 pile-on + 5 per lean + 3 per other lopsided market. liability_rank orders games by that score. The board list (rank) is sorted by pick strength: ●●● firm plays first, then ●● leans by confidence, then Watch only games by house liability.
rules_summary.must_win: House liability score 85+ and in the top 5 scores of the week (max 5).

firm.Division Dog Must-Win: Must-Win where the house side is a division underdog.
firm.Promoted: 2+ side leans on the same side (Home Darling Fade, Darling Favorite Fade, Dallas Fade).

rules_summary.elite_exception: Never fade a team with a top-5 record (ties at 5th included).

totals.Smart-Money Over: Over money 15+ pts above Over bets.
totals.Public Over Fade: Under when 70%+ of money is on the Over, money not 15+ above bets, and no Smart-Money/Dallas Over. Lean only.
totals.weather_block: Overs blocked by wind 12+ mph, rain or snow, or 40F and colder.

data_levels.FULL: 2 independent sources within 10 pts (rules run on the average).
data_levels.DISAGREE: 2 sources more than 10 pts apart; a pick counts only if it passes on EACH source.
data_levels.THIN: Only 1 source; no firm plays, would-be firm shows ●● "Would be firm. Needs a second source." and CAUTION · Thin data.
data_levels.game_level: NONE if all markets NONE, DISAGREE if any market DISAGREE, FULL if all FULL, otherwise THIN.

dots.●●●: Firm spread play (Promoted or Division Dog Must-Win). 1 unit. VIP.
dots.●●: Tested totals lean, small ML (0.25-0.5u) on a firm-play dog, or a would-be firm play on THIN data.

rules_summary.confidence: win % = 100 x (W + 10) / (W + L + 20) using the pick type record. One-lean side picks cap at 45%, Early Reads cap at 50%.
rules_summary.sources: Splits: Action Network public betting + WiseGuy NFL splits (independent). ScoresAndOdds = same feed as Action Network, never counted twice. Lines: DraftKings via Action Network. Standings and injuries: ESPN. Weather: Open-Meteo.
